title: Repo Path Budget
description: Bring every repo path outside the norm plugin under the taxonomy 240-byte budget. Fresh census of path-too-long files, decide per plugin whether option B (one-emoji case directories plus a short slug, with minimal kind renames) suffices or another shortening is required, apply it with every reference updated at once, and re-run crate tests, feature cases, schema lints, and the taxonomy path check until zero path-too-long findings remain. Do not edit the norm plugin; that work belongs to 26/09/30/NON-DESTRUCTIVE-HISTORY-EDITING.
